cim: Digital Realty Trust to spend $10bn more on Japan data centers: CEO

cim_eredeti: Digital Realty Trust to spend $10bn more on Japan data centers: CEO
szoveg_eredeti:
US company to nearly quadruple capacity in biggest Asian foothold

Digital Realty Trust CEO Andy Power. At right, one of the company's data centers in Japan. (Photos by Naoko Inoue and Akitoshi Sugiura)

TOKYO -- U.S.-based data center operator Digital Realty Trust will spend $10 billion in Japan, its top investment destination in Asia, over the next decade as it bets on continued demand for computing power, according to CEO Andy Power.
